# MCP tool reference

<!-- Generated by `sidekick.mcp.export_tool_reference` from `contracts/mcp-tools.generated.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Sidekick exposes 95 MCP tools: 70 that Claude can call and 25 that only the MCP App rooms call. The executable truth is the generated contract, [contracts/mcp-tools.generated.json](../../../contracts/mcp-tools.generated.json); these pages are rendered from it and a test fails when the two differ.

- **Access** is `read` for tools that change nothing and `write` for tools that create or change records; `write (destructive)` marks writes that remove or overwrite data.
- **Scopes** are what the server enforces. They come from the code, not from this text: the scope of each use case, plus the read scope the reply of a write tool needs (`sidekick.mcp.reply_scopes`). A tool that works per kind of record answers with the kinds the session can read.
- **Returns** names the top-level fields of the structured answer.
- Almost every write takes an `idempotency_key` (a retry does not repeat the change) or an expected `version` (a stale write is refused).
- Parameters marked `required` must be present; every other parameter can be left out.

## Model-visible tools

### [Tasks and boards](tasks.md)

- [`list_tasks`](tasks.md#list_tasks): Use this for a bounded, paged list of tasks, optionally filtered by project_id, process_id or status. (read)
- [`get_task`](tasks.md#get_task): Get one owned task by its Sidekick UUID. (read)
- [`create_task`](tasks.md#create_task): Use this when the user wants a new task, standalone or under a Project or Process. (write)
- [`create_tasks`](tasks.md#create_tasks): Use this when the user wants several new tasks at once, for example from a photo of a whiteboard or a list. (write)
- [`update_task`](tasks.md#update_task): Update explicit fields of one owned task at its current version; retry-safe with the same idempotency key. (write)
- [`complete_task`](tasks.md#complete_task): Mark one owned task complete using its current version. (write)
- [`reschedule_tasks`](tasks.md#reschedule_tasks): Use this when the user wants to move 1 to 20 tasks at once, for example to tomorrow, next week (Monday), a given date, or to clear the due date. (write)
- [`get_work_board`](tasks.md#get_work_board): Use this for the Status view: one bounded page of Work records in manual order, grouped into status columns. (read)
- [`get_work_agenda`](tasks.md#get_work_agenda): Use this for one bounded page of dated Work records, grouped as overdue, today, upcoming or scheduled later. (read)

### [Steps and actions](steps-and-actions.md)

- [`list_task_steps`](steps-and-actions.md#list_task_steps): List bounded ordered Steps for one owned Task, each with its action_count; next_cursor continues. (read)
- [`create_task_step`](steps-and-actions.md#create_task_step): Create an ordered Step under one owned Task with a retry-safe key. (write)
- [`update_task_step`](steps-and-actions.md#update_task_step): Update a Step with optimistic version checking. (write)
- [`complete_task_step`](steps-and-actions.md#complete_task_step): Complete a Step with optimistic version checking. (write)
- [`list_step_actions`](steps-and-actions.md#list_step_actions): List bounded display-ordered Actions for one owned Step; next_cursor continues. (read)
- [`create_step_action`](steps-and-actions.md#create_step_action): Create an ordered Action under one owned Step with a retry-safe key. (write)
- [`update_step_action`](steps-and-actions.md#update_step_action): Update an Action with optimistic version checking. (write)
- [`complete_step_action`](steps-and-actions.md#complete_step_action): Complete an Action with optimistic version checking. (write)

### [External references](external-references.md)

- [`link_external_reference_to_task`](external-references.md#link_external_reference_to_task): Attach a mail, calendar event or document the user asked to link, found through their own connector, to a known Task (Task id, for example from get_work_agenda). (write)
- [`list_task_external_references`](external-references.md#list_task_external_references): Use this after a Task UUID is known to list the pointers (title, https link, provider) attached to it, bounded and paginated. (read)

### [Projects, domains, processes, tags and saved views](work-hierarchy.md)

- [`get_work_hierarchy`](work-hierarchy.md#get_work_hierarchy): Use this for the structure of the user's Work: Domains, Processes and Projects as one bounded page of nodes linked by parent_id. (read)
- [`list_domains`](work-hierarchy.md#list_domains): List bounded domains owned by the authenticated user. (read)
- [`create_domain`](work-hierarchy.md#create_domain): Use this when the user wants a new Domain, the top-level area that groups Projects and Processes; create it before a Project that needs it. (write)
- [`update_domain`](work-hierarchy.md#update_domain): Update explicit fields of one owned domain at its current version; retry-safe with the same idempotency key. (write)
- [`list_processes`](work-hierarchy.md#list_processes): List bounded ongoing Processes owned by the authenticated user, optionally by Domain. (read)
- [`create_process`](work-hierarchy.md#create_process): Create one ongoing Process under an owned Domain with a retry-safe idempotency key. (write)
- [`update_process`](work-hierarchy.md#update_process): Update explicit fields of one owned Process at its current version; retry-safe with the same idempotency key. (write)
- [`list_projects`](work-hierarchy.md#list_projects): Use this for a bounded list of the user's projects. (read)
- [`get_project`](work-hierarchy.md#get_project): Get one owned project by its Sidekick UUID, including its current fields. (read)
- [`create_project`](work-hierarchy.md#create_project): Use this when the user wants a new project. (write)
- [`update_project`](work-hierarchy.md#update_project): Update explicit fields of one owned project at its current version; retry-safe with the same idempotency key. (write)
- [`list_tags`](work-hierarchy.md#list_tags): List the authenticated user's own tag vocabulary as a bounded page, with its use per kind (only kinds you may read). (read)

### [Contacts](contacts.md)

- [`list_contacts`](contacts.md#list_contacts): Use this to resolve a person the user mentions (name, alias, email or phone) to a Contact id. (read)
- [`get_contact_context`](contacts.md#get_contact_context): Use this after the Contact id is known, for example from list_contacts or create_contact, to retrieve that owned active Contact, bounded current Project/Task context and up to 10 newest linked Journal entries (id, date and title only; read a Journal entry for its content), or to answer who a Contact is. (read)
- [`list_task_contacts`](contacts.md#list_task_contacts): Use this after a Task UUID is known to list the owned Contacts linked to that Task as a bounded, paginated page of Contact summaries. (read)
- [`create_contact`](contacts.md#create_contact): Use this only when the user has asked to create one Contact. (write)
- [`update_contact`](contacts.md#update_contact): Use this for explicit edits to one known owned active Contact. (write)
- [`archive_contact`](contacts.md#archive_contact): Use this when the user explicitly wants to hide one known Contact from active views. (write)
- [`restore_contact`](contacts.md#restore_contact): Use this when the user explicitly wants to return one archived owned Contact to active views. (write)
- [`add_contact_alias`](contacts.md#add_contact_alias): Use this to add one alternative name to a known active Contact using its current version. (write)
- [`link_contact_to_project`](contacts.md#link_contact_to_project): Use this after the Contact and Project ids are known, for example from list_contacts, create_contact, list_projects or get_work_hierarchy. (write)
- [`link_contact_to_task`](contacts.md#link_contact_to_task): Use this after the Contact and Task ids are known, for example from list_contacts, create_contact, list_projects or get_work_hierarchy. (write)

### [Journal](journal.md)

- [`list_journal_entries`](journal.md#list_journal_entries): Use this for a bounded date-filtered list of at most 366 inclusive calendar days of the authenticated user's journal entries, oldest first. (read)
- [`get_journal_entry`](journal.md#get_journal_entry): Use this for one known owned entry UUID, usually from a list result, when the user asks to see that entry. (read)
- [`get_journal_day`](journal.md#get_journal_day): Use this for bounded entries and summary status on one explicit date. (read)
- [`get_journal_source`](journal.md#get_journal_source): Use this for one known owned source UUID to read its immutable provenance: type, dates, language, replacement link, and fingerprint. (read)
- [`list_pending_journal`](journal.md#list_pending_journal): Use this for a bounded list of preserved sources on one explicit date range that still await manual or AI-assisted review, with draft state and no source text. (read)
- [`write_journal_entry`](journal.md#write_journal_entry): Use this when the user asks to write or save a journal entry (e.g. "write my journal"). (write)
- [`update_journal_entry`](journal.md#update_journal_entry): Use this to add to, correct or relink an existing journal entry (e.g. 'add to today's journal'); read it first and send its current version. (write)
- [`set_daily_journal_summary`](journal.md#set_daily_journal_summary): Use this when the user asks you to write or replace the daily journal summary for one explicit date. (write)
- [`get_journal_draft`](journal.md#get_journal_draft): Use this only when the user wants to review one known owned AI-derived journal draft UUID. (read)

### [Shopping](shopping.md)

- [`list_shopping_lists`](shopping.md#list_shopping_lists): List owned shopping lists, bounded and paginated. (read)
- [`get_shopping_list`](shopping.md#get_shopping_list): Read one owned shopping list and open its interactive app. (read)
- [`create_shopping_list`](shopping.md#create_shopping_list): On the user's explicit request, create one named shopping list. (write)
- [`update_shopping_list`](shopping.md#update_shopping_list): Explicitly rename, archive or restore one owned list using its current version. (write)
- [`add_shopping_items`](shopping.md#add_shopping_items): Commit 1-50 user-reviewed items atomically to one owned active list; on failure none are added. (write)
- [`update_shopping_item`](shopping.md#update_shopping_item): Change one owned item at its current version. (write)
- [`set_shopping_item_purchased`](shopping.md#set_shopping_item_purchased): Explicitly mark one owned shopping item purchased or wanted again, with version checking and append-only history. (write)
- [`set_shopping_items_purchased`](shopping.md#set_shopping_items_purchased): Explicitly mark 1-50 owned shopping items purchased or wanted again in one atomic call, for example everything bought in a shop. (write)

### [Overview and changes](overview.md)

- [`get_today_brief`](overview.md#get_today_brief): Use this when the user asks how today stands, or a scheduled morning or evening check needs the day at a glance. (read)
- [`show_work_changes`](overview.md#show_work_changes): Call this at most once, as the last tool call, after a series of Work writes (domain, project, task or step creates and updates) in the same turn. (read)
- [`list_recent_changes`](overview.md#list_recent_changes): Use this when the user asks what they changed last, or to undo it. (read)

### [Search and memory](search-and-memory.md)

- [`search`](search-and-memory.md#search): Use this to find records by words when no id is known: searches the user's Tasks, Projects, Contacts and Journal (kinds narrows it). (read)
- [`recall_memory`](search-and-memory.md#recall_memory): Use when the user asks what they know, said, felt or decided about a person, project, place or period, or when search finds nothing. (read)
- [`get_memory_status`](search-and-memory.md#get_memory_status): Use this when the user asks whether memory works or what it covers. (read)
- [`set_memory_settings`](search-and-memory.md#set_memory_settings): Use this to turn memory on or off per domain (journal, contacts, projects, tasks) or to pause it. (write (destructive))
- [`exclude_from_memory`](search-and-memory.md#exclude_from_memory): Use this to keep one journal entry, contact, project or task out of memory, or back in with excluded=false. (write)

### [Trash and activity](trash-and-activity.md)

- [`list_trash`](trash-and-activity.md#list_trash): Use this to see the authenticated user's recoverable trash, newest first, optionally narrowed to one record kind. (read)
- [`move_to_trash`](trash-and-activity.md#move_to_trash): Use this only after asking the user and getting an explicit yes in this turn to move this record to the trash. (write (destructive))
- [`restore_from_trash`](trash-and-activity.md#restore_from_trash): Use this when the user wants something back from the trash. (write)
- [`list_assistant_activity`](trash-and-activity.md#list_assistant_activity): Use this for a bounded, newest-first page of the authenticated user's own Activity Center entries: what changed, by whom, and in which state. (read)

## App-only tools

The [25 app-only tools](app-only.md) are called by the MCP App rooms and are hidden from the model:

- Tasks and boards: [`reorder_work_board_column`](app-only.md#reorder_work_board_column)
- Steps and actions: [`archive_task_step`](app-only.md#archive_task_step), [`restore_task_step`](app-only.md#restore_task_step), [`reorder_task_steps`](app-only.md#reorder_task_steps), [`archive_step_action`](app-only.md#archive_step_action), [`restore_step_action`](app-only.md#restore_step_action), [`reorder_step_actions`](app-only.md#reorder_step_actions)
- External references: [`unlink_external_reference_from_task`](app-only.md#unlink_external_reference_from_task)
- Projects, domains, processes, tags and saved views: [`get_domain`](app-only.md#get_domain), [`get_process`](app-only.md#get_process), [`list_saved_work_views`](app-only.md#list_saved_work_views), [`create_saved_work_view`](app-only.md#create_saved_work_view), [`update_saved_work_view`](app-only.md#update_saved_work_view), [`archive_saved_work_view`](app-only.md#archive_saved_work_view), [`restore_saved_work_view`](app-only.md#restore_saved_work_view)
- Contacts: [`remove_contact_alias`](app-only.md#remove_contact_alias), [`unlink_contact_from_project`](app-only.md#unlink_contact_from_project), [`unlink_contact_from_task`](app-only.md#unlink_contact_from_task)
- Journal: [`get_daily_journal_summary`](app-only.md#get_daily_journal_summary), [`create_journal_source`](app-only.md#create_journal_source), [`create_manual_journal_entry`](app-only.md#create_manual_journal_entry), [`update_journal_draft`](app-only.md#update_journal_draft), [`reject_journal_draft`](app-only.md#reject_journal_draft), [`finalize_journal_draft`](app-only.md#finalize_journal_draft)
- License: [`set_license_key`](app-only.md#set_license_key)
